messages:
alyssa: FYI — postmortem action intake for Mariner Health (Dedicated/Private). Root cause looks like a combo of a VPC peering flap and an on-prem routing drift that exposed an isolation bug. Need owners and timelines. ping @jon @sam

jon: I can take ownership of the peering side. Immediate next step: collect BGP state + peering logs. Will produce repro steps by EOD today.

sam: I'll own the on-prem routing constraints and the config drift audit. Proposal: run a config diff across the last 30 days and identify any automation gaps. I'll prep the script tomorrow.

leah: SRE note — we should enable a temporary traffic quarantine rule for the Mariner tenant so affected workloads are isolated while we remediate. I can put the rule in place at 09:30 PT if folks agree.

maria: Created tracking ticket INF-5421 and added the initial checklist. Linking runbooks and the query I used to find affected hosts. Ticket link: https://redwood.infra/INF-5421 (internal).

remediation-bot: Incident tracker updated: INF-5421 assigned to jon,sam. Reminder set for 48h follow-up.

alyssa: Action items (summary) — please confirm ownership and ETA inline.
- A1: Reproduce VPC peering flap and capture dump (owner: jon) — ETA: 2024-04-12 EOD
- A2: Patch isolation bug in runtime routing validation (owner: jon) — ETA: 2024-04-19
- A3: On-prem config drift audit + reconciliation playbook (owner: sam) — ETA: 2024-04-16
- A4: Temporary tenant quarantine rule + smoke tests (owner: leah) — ETA: 2024-04-11 09:30 PT
- A5: Customer communication draft + timeline (owner: maria) — ETA: 2024-04-13

jon: Confirmed A1/A2. Will attach logs to INF-5421. For A2: quick mitigation is a validation gate in the deployment pipeline; longer-term fix needs runtime patch.

sam: Confirmed A3. I'll run config-diff today and post results to the ticket. If we find >2 mismatched nodes, I want a pre-approved outage window.

leah: Confirmed A4. I'll post the quarantine rule snippet after I apply and run the smoke tests.

maria: I'll draft the customer note after we have A1 repro and A4 applied. Aim to send a short update within 24h.

alyssa: Good. Two weekly cadence notes: 1) Add this incident to the recurring 'isolation patterns' review deck (ops-review). 2) If post-remediation we still see >1/week peering flaps, we'll trigger a deeper infra postmortem.

jon: Quick command I ran for BGP state: ```show ip bgp summary | include Mariner``` will paste full output to INF-5421.

sam: Config diff snippet I plan to use: ```git --no-pager diff --name-only --diff-filter=M origin/main@{30.days.ago}..origin/main```

leah: small UX note for on-call: add a one-liner in the runbook about when to enable tenant quarantine to avoid accidental customer impact.

maria: Added owners and ETA to INF-5421. Will set the 48h check-in reminder for 2024-04-13 11:00 PT.

alyssa: Thanks all. Please update INF-5421 as you make progress, and ping here for any blocker that needs immediate escalation. We'll reconvene in 48h. :thumbsup:
